facts.text: Connection controls serial interfacing with CHEMYX syringe pumps
The constructor takes a port and a baudrate that MUST match the pump's System Settings
openConnection opens the serial line with timeout 0 and calls getPumpStatus
A command is written as text followed by a carriage return
The upstream waits 0.4 s after a command before it reads the reply
In multipump mode a set command is prefixed with the current pump number
start, stop, pause and restart are sent as those four words
setUnits maps mL/min, mL/hr, microlitre/min and microlitre/hr to 0, 1, 2 and 3
setDiameter, setRate, setVolume, setDelay and setTime send 'set <name> <value>'
setRate, setVolume and setDelay join a list value with commas for a multi-step run

getParameterLimits, getParameters, getDisplacedVolume, getElapsedTime and getPumpStatus send the query words 'read limit parameter', 'view parameter', 'dispensed volume', 'elapsed time' and 'pump status'
The GUI parses the getParameters reply by the line indexes 1, 2, 6, 3 and 7 for units, diameter, volume, rate and delay and takes the last space-separated token as the value
The GUI treats a negative volume as withdraw
The GUI labels the syringe diameter in millimetres and the delay in seconds
The upstream instructions say the baud rate must match the value in the pump's System Settings

operator_required.reason: the clone states no numeric diameter range; the site supplies the envelope of the installed syringe

operator_required.name: rate
operator_required.reason: the clone states no numeric flow-rate range; the site supplies the range of the installed syringe and tubing in the selected unit

operator_required.name: volume
operator_required.reason: the clone states no numeric volume range; the site supplies the volume envelope in the selected unit

operator_required.name: delay
operator_required.reason: the clone states no numeric delay range; the site supplies the delay envelope

operator_required.name: time
operator_required.reason: the clone sends the time value without a unit and states no range; the site supplies the envelope

safe_state.description: pump stopped with the stop command; no new motion starts until a start action
